_scores.setting: 2 = their own job at work, 1 = realistic tasks done by professionals, 0 = students or lab puzzles
_scores.tool: per component: 2 = the same fix, 1 = the same kind of tool used differently, 0 = different
_scores.outcome: 2 = time on the task, 1 = output per hour or another proxy, 0 = self-report only
_scores.se: Enter the paper's standard error, or ci_low and ci_high. Until then the engine uses 1/sqrt(n) and flags it.
_scores.provenance: Entries copied from the team's Phase 4 prompt; effect sizes not yet re-checked against the papers.
